reviews.title: Crashed on me during a thru hike!
reviews.text:
FarOut crashed on me during a recent thru hike on the Foothills Trail. I shut it down late evening after getting to camp. It would not restart the next morning. It would go to the red screen and locked up. The trail has splotchy cell service so it was two days before I could get it back up and running. When I finally got cell service I shut my phone completely down and brought it back up , sighed out of FarOut and signed back in and it started working again.
Hooter Hikes

reviews.title: 😭 Downloaded guide
reviews.text: When I am out of service and spend what I did on a guide it should work. 3 days into my 80 mile river trip the downloaded guide stopped working.  Nice when it actually works. WOULD NOT DEPEND ON. Especially if out of service.

reviews.title: good for PCT, not the Camino
reviews.text: Not so good for the Camino del Norte - directs you into a dangerous road walk heading into san vincente; both gronze and wise pilgrim are better alternatives

reviews.title: Failed when I needed it most
reviews.text: Bought this. DOWNLOADED specific area map for offline use. Got to trailhead, all looked good. Got three miles in, all looked good. Note that I was on airplane mode and app worked great. Then about five miles in near a 12,000 pass, storm blowing in and no trail visible — the app goes black. Nothing. No map. Nothing. Restart the app. Nothing. Restart phone. Nothing. Black screen. Cannot zoom out, in. Nothing. Dead app. Fortunately I had another app on my phone that wasn’t as sexy, BUT THE OTHER APP WORKED! Not as detailed or nifty as this one (when it worked), but that other app got me on the trail and off the pass before the lightning and hail hit. When this app works, 5/5. But when I needed it most, it totally failed. -5/5. And yes, I tested it without cell and without wifi several times and it worked. Do not recommend for critical situations.

reviews.title: Froze during JMT hike
reviews.text: While the water and comment features are good, do not rely on this for your navigation.  After day 3 it quit working.  When I opened the app it just froze.  Restarting phone and app did nothing.  A friend off trail gave suggestions through my Garmin in Reach but none worked.  The app froze a couple of days later for the person I was hiking with.  It’s unacceptable for a back country navigation app to completely lock up and become useless.  Fortunately we had paper maps and used Strava to track time and miles traveled.  HAVE MAPS DOWNLOADED ON A DIFFERENT APP.  DO NOT RELY solely on FarOut.

reviews.title: The Bandwagon of Mediocrity!
reviews.text: FarOut, an essential app for all hikes! Glad to see they hopped on the modern app development bandwagon of unstable glitchy mediocrity. New aesthetics > functionality. All these apps change for the sake of change and nothing more, using the same cookie cutter formula and it is soooooooooooo bad.

reviews.title: App is Buggy
reviews.text:
Overall the app offers a great experience. I have purchased all the PCT Apps and used for many years.

There is one major issue that all of you should be aware of. It has been around awhile and still not fixed. 

Do not have the app open while turning your phone off airplane mode. If you do it will do a search probably to see if you have a subscription or purchase.  If you have poor cell service the link to your maps disappear.  

The dowloaded maps remain but you can’t access. 

If however you created a route, you can access those and get access to the downloaded maps and comments.   

I am guessing most people don’t have routes created so you are in danger of loosing access to maps while on trail.  

This is one of the reasons, I have paper maps and a compass. But I am guessing many users don’t have this as a back up. 

So this could be a safety issue.

reviews.title: Buggy
reviews.text: Long standing disappearing comment bug remains unfixed. Been a problem for over  a year and multiple versions. Should be a five star but I have zero confidence in the app.

reviews.title: Not great for OR and WA hikes
reviews.text: Not finding this app useful at all. Doesn’t show the full trails. No public comments or anything on any of the trails Ive looked at so far. Way too hard to use and no back button. See no benefit over AllTrails. Waste of money

reviews.title: Unusable after 3 days on trail
reviews.text: The app is fine for planning while you have internet, but BEWARE of using it as your sole source for navigation on trail.  My experience is it just stops working after about 3 days.  It opens then freezes.  The fix is to reinstall which isn’t going to happen easily on a thru hike.  I know.  I had backups for navigation and luckily I was in the Sierras where water is plentiful.  Be safe out there and DO NOT DEPEND ON THIS APP AS A NAVIGATION APP it will stop working just when you need it.

reviews.title: Epic trail failure
reviews.text: I’ve used farout for several years now on a few trails. In July I hiked the wonderland trail and my app wouldn’t respond, the screen would freeze, and it wouldn’t record my route. I uninstalled and reinstalled the app, same problem. Luckily my hiking partner also had the app and was having no issues. I meant to contact farout back then and ask for a refund for that trail since it wasn’t cheap and was totally useless. I forgot. Now I’m preparing to hike another section of the Appalachian Trail and the app is having the same issue. My screen is frozen and there’s nothing that I can do about it. Not only that, but FarOut has not even made it easy for you to contact Support. There are a bunch of tutorial and frequently ask questions but no way it seems to contact the developer to get help directly. This is obviously case in point why you can’t rely on technology alone and should always have a backup. I’ve loved this app for years but this glitch that seems impossible to fix is ruining it. Please make support easier to contact.

reviews.title: Grand Canyon Whitewater
reviews.text: DO NOT PURCHASE THIS APP! It’s a complete waste of money. It will provide you with the maps but does not update the current GPS location. I just spent the last 25 days on the river laughing at how useless this app is. CalTopo worked, AllTrails worked, FarOut Grand Canyon Whitewater did not. Total garbage.
